notes: Calendar tidy-up: Apply now works through the calendar a few events at a time, so it no longer stops with “No reply”; a tick box at the top ticks or unticks them all; Apply is on the left and Close on the right
Calendar page: the picture underneath is drawn in the view it opens on – 3 months, 3 months (scroll), Month or Week – and changes as you change it
Adding to the calendar on the screen: + Add, tap the day, and a box opens – what it is, all day (until another day) or at a time, the category and notes
The dot by the title is always round; hover or tap it to see why it’s red, and it tries again by itself
Every device can be disconnected – the screen (tap the version), the phone (More → Disconnect this phone), the calendar app and the Configurator (Home) – and goes back to “connect to a dashboard”
Everywhere says which family: “the MacMillan family dashboard (Ben, Josh…)”
